instructions.name: Initialize
expected_state_changes: initializes the guardian-set / bridge configuration account
risk_rules: one-time bootstrap: config must be uninitialized
guardian set is fixed at deploy — changes are guarded by multi-sig

instructions.name: PostMessage
expected_state_changes: creates a signed message (VAA payload) account with the emitter's payload
fee is deducted from the emitter when configured
risk_rules: emitter must be signer — only registered emitters may post
RISK: bridge messages move wrapped assets cross-chain — verify no unexpected token CPI
RISK: if message payload claims a transfer to an attacker address, flag HiddenTransfer

instructions.name: PostVAA
expected_state_changes: processes a signed VAA, unlocking assets on the destination chain
risk_rules: RISK: VAA is attacker-supplied data — verify signature set is the CURRENT guardian set
RISK: if VAA unlocks assets to an attacker account, flag CompositionalDrain
FAIL-CLOSED: bridge token movement with unverifiable VAA provenance must be blocked

instructions.name: VerifySignatures
expected_state_changes: verifies guardian signatures over the VAA hash
risk_rules: signature threshold must meet the current guardian-set quorum
RISK: partial signature verification is not final — flag if used as final

instructions.name: PostMessageUnreliable
expected_state_changes: posts a message without guaranteed delivery ordering
